"Lymph node surgically resected at age 3; transfusion for pancytopenia at 7.5 years; hydroxychloroquine, mycophenolate mofetil, prednisone and rituximab (two 500 mg doses at age 10) added for SLE-like flares (ages 8-11); MMF discontinued and broad spectrum antibiotics at age 11 for neutropenic fevers; HCQ continued and prednisone tapered off at ages 12-14; monthly IVIG replacement started for hypogammaglobulinemia and recurrent infections; at age 15 escalation with prednisone, MMF (1,000 mg twice daily) and two 1000 mg doses of rituximab plus ongoing HCQ and monthly IVIG, with improving lymphadenopathy"
"Whole exome sequencing of this patient and both parents also revealed that this patient’s mutation is a de novo mutation, as neither parent harbors the p.Q593X pathogenic variant."
